findings: The underline is rejected outright as an instrument, in both profiles and on every row.

The earlier rejection was misread. The tint was never the problem in the standard light and dark profiles, where the reviewer reports it works well; the objection was specific to the high-contrast profiles. Generalising it into 'a fill cannot carry this mark' was an over-reading that cost a round.
High contrast should use a different and genuinely high-contrast colour pairing rather than a deeper shade of the row, with the pairing left to the implementer's judgement.
The selected-row direction in the standard profiles is still not right, though the reviewer saw it only with an underline drawn over it.
